text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle asks me to watch her<n>dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's get this show on the road!<n>Ready to dance,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ya sure are! It's no fun dancin' solo!
Good to go? I'm starting the music!
Caught off guard, I find myself<n>dancing with Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's so much fun dancin' with<n>ya, Trainer!
You okay? You seem a little tuckered<n>out.
choice_data_list: Could you teach me the choreography first?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You okay? You seem a little tuckered<n>out.
choice_data_list: Could you teach me the choreography first?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? Sounds good to me! I'd<n>love to keep
dancin' with ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This here studio is our very own<n>dance floor! Ain't
nobody gonna get<n>in our way!

I'm puttin' the music back on! So<n>let's kick up our
heels! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We continue to dance right up until the<n>final school
bell chimes.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did I jump the gun? Sorry 'bout<n>that! All right,
this time we'll take it<n>nice and slow!
Try to follow my lead, Trainer! ♪

Let's see... First of all, ya gotta lift<n>your arms like
this...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Walking me through the<n>choreography seems to aid
in Taiki<n>Shuttle's own improvement as well.
